title: h5info
summary: Return metadata for an HDF5 file, group, or dataset.

gpu_support.notes: Metadata traversal is host file I/O.

description: `h5info(filename)` and `h5info(filename, location)` return recursive HDF5 metadata structures.
behaviors: Groups include attributes, subgroups, datasets, datatypes, and links fields.
Datasets include datatype, class, dataspace, size, and attributes fields.
